$comment: Copy to config/leagues.json. This file is the ONLY place credentials live — each league's `accessCode` (min 3 chars, e.g. a 4-letter code) unlocks that league, and `adminCode` unlocks everything plus the admin panel. In production, mount the containing directory as /app/config so codes can change without rebuilding. Run `npm run leagues:discover -- --username <you>` to list your league IDs.

managerAliases.$comment: map a stale Sleeper user_id to the canonical one it should merge into, e.g. "0000000000": "1111111111"

displayNameOverrides.$comment: map a Sleeper user_id to the name to show instead of their display_name
